item.title: Chatha Pacha Kerala Box Office Collections: Arjun Ashokan, Roshan Mathew's film posts GOOD 1st weekend, grosses Rs 11 cr in 4 days
item.description: Malayalam film Chatha Pacha: The Ring of Rowdies is recording a good hold at the box office. After taking an opening of Rs. 3.75 crore, the sports action comedy drama slipped to Rs. 2.20 crore on Day 2, registering a drop of 40 percent. It further witnessed a muted growth and collected Rs. 2.50 crore on Day 3. Estimates suggest that the movie registered another spike on Day 4 (Sunday), adding Rs. 2.75 crore to the tally.
